summary_1line: Bhishma explains the divine origin of kingship through Prithu and begins outlining the general and class-specific duties of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Earth in human form approaches King Prithu and offers him tribute of glittering gems and jewels.
King Prithu levels the rugged earth, striking rocks aside with the horn of his bow as mountains rise around him.
A golden lotus springs from Vishnu’s brow and the goddess Sree emerges radiant from its petals.
